title: Spell: Double It
story: Chilaka learns a spell. A function is a spell you write once and cast as many times as you like.
goal: Define a function double(x) that gives back x times 2.
starter: # define double(x) so that double(4) gives back 8
hints: A function starts with def, a name, brackets with parameters, and a colon.
Use return to hand the answer back to whoever called the function.
socratic: What is the difference between printing a value and returning it?
What is the parameter called in double(x)?
explain: In one sentence: what does return do?

example.title: Worked example: a square function
example.note: def names the function, return hands a value back to the caller.
